debate.key_bull_argument: Strong technical structure (price above all major MAs, supertrend bullish, three white soldiers) combined with contrarian congressional buying and extreme market fear (VIX 228.96) creates asymmetric risk/reward for scaled entry.
debate.key_bear_argument: Overbought momentum (RSI 73.39, Stoch 84.46), weak trend strength (ADX 17.43), below-average volume support (0.72 ratio), earnings event risk in 42 days, and severe macro headwinds (inverted yield curve, recession signals) outweigh technical bullish setup.
